# Framework Adapters — Shared Mental Model

> Per-framework specifics → adapters-react.md · adapters-vue.md · adapters-angular.md.

## shared architecture

- PATTERN: global singleton adapter registered at module load (React/Vue) or DI (Angular).
- FLOW: adapter registered → grid parses light DOM → `processConfig()` wraps framework components in bridge fns → grid calls renderer → bridge mounts it into the cell container.
- INVARIANT: the adapter MUST be registered BEFORE the grid parses light DOM. One adapter per app.
- INTERFACE: `processConfig`, `createComponentRenderer`, `createComponentEditor`, `releaseCell`, plus `CORE_CONSUMED_ADAPTER_METHODS`.
- DECIDED (#330): `beginBatch?()` / `endBatch?()` defer per-cell teardown across bulk `releaseCell` loops (`_clearRowPool`, `renderVisibleRows` pool-shrink, `renderInlineRow` pre-wipe). Calls NEST — outermost `endBatch` flushes. Vue/Angular are no-ops.
- DECIDED (#338/#340, reverted): adapter Context / `InjectionKey` / `InjectionToken` are plain module constants, MUST NOT be routed through `globalThis` (rationale: grid-core.md § shared-store). Micro-frontend `customElements.define` collision: #339.

## adapter conformance

- OWNS: `CORE_CONSUMED_ADAPTER_METHODS` in `libs/grid/src/lib/core/adapter-conformance.ts`, re-exported from `public.ts`.
- INVARIANT: every adapter ships `<framework>-grid-adapter.conformance.spec.ts` that fails when a listed method is missing on the instance (React/Vue) or prototype (Angular — ctor needs DI). When core adds a hook it depends on, APPEND to `CORE_CONSUMED_ADAPTER_METHODS` so all three specs go red.
- DECIDED: only the constant is exported from `public.ts`; helper fns stay internal (exporting them pushed `index.js` over budget); each spec inlines a 2-line filter.

| Framework | Registration    | Event idiom                             | Programmatic access          |
| --------- | --------------- | --------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| React     | module load     | props `onCellClick` (`event-props.ts`)  | `useGrid<TRow>()` hook       |
| Vue       | module load     | emits `@cell-click="handler"`           | `useGrid<TRow>()` composable |
| Angular   | `provideGrid()` | outputs `(cellClick)="handler($event)"` | `injectGrid()`               |

## adapter feature purity

- DECIDED (May 2026): adapter cores (`{react,vue,angular}-grid-adapter.ts`, `react-column-config.ts`) MUST NOT runtime-reference feature behaviour (type-only imports OK). Runtime wiring lives in `features/<name>.ts` (React/Vue) or `features/<name>/src/` (Angular) secondary entries.
- DECIDED (#356 phase 7): the cross-adapter registry surface is re-exported from each adapter's primary `index.ts`. Symbol list + applicability: `.github/instructions/framework-adapters.instructions.md` ("Cross-adapter registry parity") — SSOT.
- INVARIANT: registries are additive-contract only (never remove/rename); adding one means mirroring it in the same PR with an identical export name + signature. Asserted by `*-grid-adapter.registry-parity.spec.ts` (Angular's also asserts React-only symbols are `undefined`).

## config-entry uniformity (component renderers via every entry point)

- INVARIANT: a framework component/JSX/VNode renderer inside `gridConfig.features.<name>` MUST be bridged to a vanilla DOM render fn IDENTICALLY to the per-feature prop/directive form. Same input → same plugin regardless of entry path. Tested per adapter.
- DECIDED: React/Vue bridge at the **feature factory** layer — `registerFeature(name, factory, { override: true })` wraps the vanilla factory with JSX/VNode→DOM bridging. WHY: `grid.ts > #initializePlugins` → `resolveFeatures` → `createPluginsFromFeatures` → `createPluginFromFeature` → `getFeatureFactory(name)` is the SINGLE chokepoint for every `config.features` entry, via props (→ `plugins[]`) or `gridConfig.features` (`processGridConfig` / `mergedConfig` spread `features` untouched). Test: `features/grouping-columns.spec.tsx`.
- DECIDED: Angular bridges at the **preprocessor** layer (`registerFeatureConfigPreprocessor`), NOT a factory override — it MUST run on BOTH entry paths. `createFeaturePlugins` (directive path) ran it; the `gridConfig.features` path (`set gridConfig` → `processConfig` interceptor) did not until a `getFeatureConfigPreprocessor(name)` loop was added (Jun 2026). SYMPTOM: `TypeError: Class constructor … cannot be invoked without 'new'` at afterRender. Tests: `angular-grid-adapter.spec.ts` "processGridConfig / processConfig".

## shell content wrappers (#352, #370)

- OWNS: React `Grid{Header,Toolbar}Content`, Vue `TbwGrid{Header,Toolbar}Content`, Angular `Grid{Header,Toolbar}Content` directives, wrapping `registerHeaderContent`/`registerToolbarContent` (specs co-located). Vue uses `<Teleport>` (slot child of `<TbwGrid>`); Angular uses `host.closest('tbw-grid')`, NOT `injectGrid()`.
- INVARIANT: the render-callback cleanup is a **no-op**; `register*` MUST `await grid.ready?.()` then guard unmount-during-await (React `unmounted` / Vue `cancelled` / Angular `destroyed`), else the registration leaks.
- INVARIANT (Angular): render MUST be idempotent — `createEmbeddedView` is not, so skip when `viewRef.rootNodes[0]` is still inside the container, else destroy the stale viewRef first. WHY: the grid reuses the SAME container by id across shell refreshes.
- DECIDED (#370, v3): wrappers route through `grid.getPluginByName?.('shell')?.{register,unregister}{Header,Toolbar}Content`; the deprecated grid-element delegates (`grid.register*Content`) are REMOVED (TS2339). Typing: `import type { HeaderContentDefinition | ToolbarContentDefinition } from '@toolbox-web/grid/plugins/shell'` (NOT the package root) activates the `PluginNameMap` augmentation — `getPluginByName('shell')` is typed, no cast. Files: `grid-react/src/lib/grid-{header,toolbar}-content.tsx`, `grid-vue/src/lib/TbwGrid{Header,Toolbar}Content.vue`, `grid-angular/src/lib/directives/grid-{header,toolbar}-content.directive.ts`. `*ShellContent*.spec.*` harnesses mock the shell plugin behind `getPluginByName('shell')`.
- DECIDED (v3 enablement): each adapter ships an opt-in `features/shell` side-effect subpath (body: `import '@toolbox-web/grid/features/shell'`) — React/Vue via `vite.config.mts` `build.lib.entry` + `src/features/index.ts`; Angular via `features/shell/{ng-package.json,src/index.ts}` (NO directive). All barrels get `_ShellAugmentation`. GOTCHA: `shell` as a global `FeatureConfig` key fires both React/Vue drift guards — `_AssertFeaturePropsCoverCore` needs `shell?: boolean | ShellConfig`; `_AssertBuiltinCoversCore` needs `'shell'` in `_KnownBuiltinGaps`. Verified by `features/shell{.spec.ts,/src/index.spec.ts}`.
- DECIDED (#260/#261/#262, v3): core no longer auto-registers ShellPlugin — shell resolves ONLY from `features:{shell}` or `plugins:[ShellPlugin]`; top-level `config.shell` alone does NOT enable it (merged by `ShellPlugin.processConfig` AFTER instantiation). Demos import `.../features/shell` and nest shell config under `features: { shell: {…} }`. RULED OUT: a child-feature detector returning `{ shell: true }` — core drops unregistered feature names (TBW031).
- INVARIANT (v3, mirrored core removals): adapter `PinnedRowsConfig` = `Omit<CorePinnedRowsConfig,'slots'> & { slots?: PinnedRowSlot[] }` (core dropped `customPanels`); shell type aliases import from `@toolbox-web/grid/plugins/shell`; `features/reorder-rows` no longer exists.
- GOTCHA (#430): `ToolPanelDefinition.title` is OPTIONAL (a title-less single panel skips its accordion header). React `GridToolPanelProps.title?`, Angular `GridToolPanel.title = input<string>()`, Vue `title?` (resolves to `''`).

## bridge registries (append-only, populated by side-effect imports)

- `registerEditorMountHook` / `notifyEditorMounted` — `editor-mount-hooks.ts` (all 3) ← `features/editing`: `before-edit-close` → native `.blur()` on the focused input.
- `registerFilterPanelTypeDefaultBridge` — each adapter ← `features/filtering`: wraps the user `filterPanelRenderer` in the framework render path.
- `registerDetailRendererBridge` / `registerResponsiveCardRendererBridge` — `{react,vue}-grid-adapter.ts` / Angular `internal/feature-bridges.ts` ← `features/master-detail`, `features/responsive`: template/component → renderer fn; the adapter method is a thin delegate.
- `registerPostMountRefresh(name, fn)` / `notifyPostMount` — `post-mount-refresh-hooks.ts` (React + Vue) ← `features/master-detail`, `features/responsive`: feature-keyed kick after children commit, so plugins created pre-children pick up renderers.
- `registerChildFeatureDetector(name, fn)` / `detectChildFeatures` — `child-feature-detector.ts` (**React only**) ← pre-registered at `data-grid.tsx` module load: scans children by `displayName` → partial `FeatureProps` to auto-enable plugins.
- `registerFeaturePropKey(name)` / `getFeaturePropKeys` — `feature-prop-keys.ts` (React + Vue) ← module-load self-registration of every built-in key: canonical `FeatureProps` keys extracted from `...rest`/declared props before `createPluginsFromFeatures`.- `registerFeatureConfigPreprocessor(name, fn)` / `getFeatureConfigPreprocessor` — `internal/feature-extensions.ts` (**Angular only**) ← `features/{grouping-columns,grouping-rows,pinned-rows,master-detail,responsive,filtering}`: Angular `TemplateRef`/`Component` in feature config → core renderer fns; invoked by `Grid.createFeaturePlugins`.
- `registerTemplateBridge` (**Angular only**) — `internal/feature-extensions.ts` ← `features/master-detail`, `features/responsive`: wires `<tbw-grid-detail>` / `<tbw-grid-responsive-card>` templates in `ngAfterContentInit`.
- DECIDED (#356 phase 7): each adapter ships ONLY the registries it invokes — React adds `registerChildFeatureDetector`; Vue omits it (slots carry templates, not feature signals); Angular has neither the detector nor `registerFeaturePropKey`/`registerPostMountRefresh` (per-feature `@Input()` directives, no `{...rest}` spread; `ngAfterContentInit` covers post-mount). RULED OUT: "ship-without-caller for API parity" — an uncalled registry is dead code.
- INVARIANT: features import from the adapter's PRIMARY entry (registry hooks + types); the primary entry MUST NOT import from feature subpaths (build cycle).
- INVARIANT: spec files exercising bridge behaviour MUST side-effect-import `'../features/<name>'` at the top, else the bridge is null and methods return `undefined`.
- DECIDED: `createToolPanelRenderer` stays on the adapter (CORE primitive — `shell.ts` parses `<tbw-grid-tool-panel>` and calls it); so do `createEditor`/`createRenderer` (per-cell primitives). `createFilterPanelRenderer` stays inline (generic node-to-container wrap).
- DECIDED (#354): adapter `pinned-rows` slot-renderer wrappers MUST cache the host element per renderer across calls. WHY: `PinnedRowsPlugin.renderPanelSlot` reference-checks renderer outputs in a `rowOutputsCache` WeakMap to skip row rebuilds; a fresh host forces React/Vue remount and Angular re-create. React/Vue cache `{host, portalKey}` → `renderToContainer(host, node, key)` + `PinnedRowsPluginWithCleanup` overriding `detach()`; Angular caches `{hostElement, componentRef}` → `setInput() + detectChanges()`. Specs: `libs/grid-{react,vue}/src/features/pinned-rows.spec.{tsx,ts}`, `libs/grid-angular/features/pinned-rows/src/cached-panel-renderer.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (#353): feature configs with renderer callbacks expose adapter-typed wrappers — `Omit<CoreConfig,'rendererProp'> & { rendererProp?: CoreConfig['rendererProp'] | FrameworkReturn }`, re-exported under the core type's canonical name via a `Core*` alias (legacy `React*`/`Vue*`/`Angular*` names REMOVED in 3.0). Covered: `FilterConfig`, `ColumnGroupDefinition`, `GroupingColumnsConfig`, `GroupingRowsConfig`, `PanelRender`, `PanelSlot`, `PinnedRowSlot`, `PinnedRowsConfig`, `ZonedPanelRender`, `MasterDetailConfig`, `ResponsivePluginConfig` (React `lib/feature-props.ts`; Vue `VNode` mirror; Angular directives widened with `| Type<unknown>`). RUNTIME: React/Vue `createPluginFromFeature` override (`*PluginWithCleanup`, `detach()` → `removeFromContainer(key)`); Angular preprocessor + `mountComponentRenderer`.
  - INVARIANT (specs): assert on `plugin.userConfig`, NOT `plugin.config` (populated only post-`attach()`, `base-plugin.ts`); Angular specs MUST `import '@angular/compiler';` before the side-effect feature module, else `@angular/forms` triggers `JIT compilation failed for PlatformLocation`.

## event props (drift-safety pattern)

- OWNS: React `EventProps<TRow>` + `EVENT_PROP_MAP` (`libs/grid-react/src/lib/event-props.ts`, bidirectional `satisfies`); Vue `EVENT_MAP` + `defineEmits` (`TbwGrid.vue`, `_emitsCoverCore`); Angular `output<T>()` + `eventOutputMap` (`directives/grid.directive.ts`, `satisfies` + `_assertEventOutputMapCoversCore`).
- INVARIANT: adding a `DataGridEventMap` entry wires ALL THREE. Each adapter has an `_IntentionallyOmittedEvents` union that must be widened to consciously skip an event.
- INVARIANT: NEVER widen `satisfies` to silence a complaint — the complaint IS the feature. Either drop the prop or add the missing `declare module '../../core/types'` augmentation. When `satisfies` rejects an event, check emit sites (`grep "_emit("`) — plugins and the registry can diverge silently.
- INVARIANT (guard shape): a drift guard MUST be a real VALUE assignment — `const _x: [Missing] extends [never] ? true : ['msg', Missing] = true;`. A `declare private x: <conditional>` or a bare `type _Assert = …` alias is NEVER checked and is silently inert (see adapters-angular.md).
- INVARIANT: missing core public exports surface as an ANGULAR build failure (not Vue/React) — Angular's `@toolbox-web/grid/all` deep import only sees `libs/grid/src/public.ts`, so new event detail types must be re-exported there.
- GOTCHA (Vue enforcement): `nx build grid-vue` runs `vite-plugin-dts`, which PRINTS SFC type errors (`error TS2322`) but exits 0 — the Vue guard is advisory at build time (hard error in-editor via Volar); blocking it needs `vue-tsc` + a `typecheck` target (plain `tsc` cannot parse `.vue`). React HAS a blocking `typecheck` target (`bunx tsc -p libs/grid-react/tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit`, in `build.dependsOn`); Angular's is blocked by ng-packagr.
- DECIDED: `EventProps` is flat (one entry per event, even paired `onUndo`/`onRedo` — a tried `onUndoRedo` bound to a non-emitted `'undo-redo'`). Hand-maintained interface + `satisfies`, NOT a mapped type (TypeDoc renders mapped types as `unknown`).
- TENSION (Angular): `eventOutputMap` keys are not statically tied to the `output<T>()` fields; a forgotten entry is a silent runtime bug.
- GOTCHA (Angular `_intentionallyOmittedEvents`): the guard proves only that the union COVERS the event map, not that each rationale is still true — a Jul 2026 audit found `tree-expand` + `tree-load-start/end/error` parked there although `grid-tree.directive.ts` existed (fixed by adding the three `tree-load-*` outputs to `GridTreeDirective`). Re-verify each omission's REASON when auditing.
- DECIDED (Jul 2026): Angular's event split — 11 grid-level events on `Grid`, 36 on per-feature directives — is idiomatic, NOT a parity gap. React/Vue expose all 47 on the root (same 3 internal-only omissions: `mount-external-editor`, `mount-external-view`, `column-reorder-request`).

## `before-edit-close` blur bridge

- DECIDED: editor `before-edit-close` → native `.blur()` on the focused input/textarea/select. WHY: Tab and programmatic row exits rebuild cell DOM synchronously, so `onBlur={commit}` / `@blur` / `(blur)` would lose pending input. Native `.blur()`, NOT a synthetic `FocusEvent` (React 17+ delegates focus via bubbling `focusout`). Angular parallel: `BaseGridEditor.onBeforeEditClose()`.
- DECIDED (#249): the bridge wires BOTH the slot/JSX `createEditor` path AND the config-path wrappers — React `wrapReactEditor`; Vue `createConfigVNodeEditor`/`createConfigComponentEditor`/`createTypeEditor`; Angular `createComponentEditor` + template `createEditor`. Tab from the last cell runs `#exitRowEdit(currentRow,false)` → `beginBulkEdit(nextRow)` synchronously, so the input never blurs naturally. Grid resolved via `queueMicrotask`.
- CLEANUP: React threads `unsub` through `mountedPortals` (`cleanupConfigRootsIn`); Vue/Angular store it in an `editorMountTeardowns` Map (container/host-keyed), swept in `releaseCell` + `destroy()`.
- DECIDED: install lives in the `editor-mount-hooks.ts` notifier (`attachBeforeEditCloseFlush` → `runEditorMountHooks`), not the adapter; installed by `features/editing`.
- TESTS: `react-column-config.spec.ts > flushes the focused input on before-edit-close`; `vue-grid-adapter.spec.ts > … for config-based VNode editor`; `angular-grid-adapter.spec.ts > before-edit-close blur bridge`.

## `releaseCell` DOM-recycle invariant (#250)

- DECIDED: core MUST call `grid.__frameworkAdapter?.releaseCell?.(cell)` BEFORE any sync wipe (`innerHTML=''` / `replaceChildren()`) of a cell holding adapter-managed renderer DOM — otherwise the framework tree references orphans and the next commit throws `NotFoundError: removeChild`.
- COVERED: `editor-injection.ts` (open editor); `renderVisibleRows` pool-shrink (`core/internal/rows.ts`); `_clearRowPool` (`grid.ts`); all guarded by `cell.firstElementChild`.
- KNOWN WEAKNESS: `GroupingRowsPlugin.ts` and `pinned-rows.ts` have `rowEl.innerHTML=''` paths that do NOT call `releaseCell` first (rely on `PortalBoundary`).
- TESTS: `rows.spec.ts > releases cells when pool shrinks`, plus per-adapter coverage.

## a11y tree is core-only (adapters emit none)

- INVARIANT: no adapter sets `role`, `aria-*` or `tabindex` — grep all three, zero hits. Renderer content mounts INSIDE the core-built, already-labelled `role="gridcell"` behind a semantics-free `display:contents` wrapper (React `div.react-cell-renderer`, Vue `div.vue-cell-renderer`, Angular bare `span`), so it can NOT break `aria-required-parent`/`-children`.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026): the axe gate `e2e/tests/accessibility.spec.ts` runs on the **vanilla demo only** — the other three re-scan byte-identical core DOM. Do NOT "fix" this with per-adapter axe suites. The only adapter-added a11y behaviour is `registerExternalFocusContainer` for overlay editors, which is behavioural (axe cannot see it) and is gated by `use-grid-overlay.spec.{tsx,ts}` + `base-overlay-editor.spec.ts`.
- INVARIANT: `conformance-report.mdx` is a procurement doc — every coverage claim MUST name a spec that asserts it (it twice claimed all four demos were scanned; never true).

## feature-prop bridging (gh #356)

Feature props auto-load plugins (React `<DataGrid selection="range" editing="dblclick" />`, Vue `:selection="'range'"`, Angular `[selection]="'range'"`). MECHANISM: feature props → `createPluginsFromFeatures()` → factories → `gridConfig.plugins`.

- DECIDED: all three adapters derive `FeatureName = Exclude<keyof FeatureConfig, '__brand'>` from core's augmentable interface, so third-party features auto-join. Strict-additive enforced by `feature-registry.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (augmentation plumbing): every adapter keeps a types-only barrel `internal/feature-augmentations.ts`, one entry per core feature. Angular uses `import type {} from '@toolbox-web/grid/features/<name>'`, pulled by `feature-registry.ts` via a **bare** `import './internal/feature-augmentations'` (NOT `import type {}` — tsc preserves bare imports through emit for ng-packagr). React/Vue use `export type { _Augmentation as _<Name>Augmentation } from '@toolbox-web/grid/features/<name>'`, which every `libs/grid-{react,vue}/src/features/*.ts` subpath MUST ALSO carry from its CORE subpath (grouping-columns/rows from `features/grouping-*`, NOT the plugin) — vite-plugin-dts STRIPS bare imports from `.d.ts`. **INVARIANT: a new core feature MUST be appended to ALL THREE barrels AND the React/Vue subpath in the same PR.** Verify: `bun nx run-many -t typedoc -p grid-react,grid-vue,grid-angular`.
- SYMPTOMS when missing: `TS2345: … '"selection"' … type 'never'` (Angular build — `FeatureName` collapsed to `never`) · `TS2322: Type '"filtering"' is not assignable to type 'FeatureName'` (`nx typedoc` only) · `TS2353` in a dist consumer importing `features/<name>`.
- DECIDED: `feature-prop-keys.ts` stores `Set<FeatureName>` + a cached frozen-array snapshot rebuilt lazily on mutation (`<DataGrid>`/`<TbwGrid>` call `getFeaturePropKeys()` every render). Guard `_AssertBuiltinCoversCore` enforces `BUILTIN ⊇ keyof FeatureConfig` minus `_KnownBuiltinGaps`.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026, audit I1): a key typed on `FeatureProps` (or declared as a `TbwGrid.vue` prop) but absent from `BUILTIN_FEATURE_PROP_KEYS` is a **silent runtime drop** — typedoc's `FeatureProps.mdx` already advertises it. Closed gaps: Vue gained `rowDragDrop`; both gained `stickyRows` in BUILTIN and Vue the `stickyRows` prop. RULED OUT: parking them in `_KnownBuiltinGaps` — that allowlist is only for keys never extracted (`shell`).
- INVARIANT: all three adapters must extract the SAME feature key set. Machine-checked by `grid-react/src/lib/feature-prop-keys.parity.spec.ts`, which reads all three sources as **text** via `readFileSync` (adapter↔adapter imports are ESLint-banned): React/Vue `BUILTIN_FEATURE_PROP_KEYS` literals, Angular's `addPlugin('…')` calls in `grid.directive.ts` `createFeaturePlugins()`. Asserts set equality modulo `FRAMEWORK_SPECIFIC` (currently **empty everywhere**), no duplicates, matching `_KnownBuiltinGaps`, and that Angular skips nothing React/Vue extract.
- DECIDED: React built-in child-feature detectors are PRE-REGISTERED at `data-grid.tsx` module load (NOT via side-effect imports), so `<GridDetailPanel>` works without importing `features/master-detail`.
- TESTS: `post-mount-refresh-hooks.spec.ts`, `child-feature-detector.spec.ts`, `feature-prop-keys.spec.ts`, `feature-registry.spec.ts` (superset assertion in all 3).

## three-way parity

- STATE (Jul 2026; prop keys re-verified Aug 2026): 25/25 feature subpath entry points byte-identical across React/Vue `src/features/*.ts` and Angular `features/*/`. 5/5 per-feature accessors identical after `useGridX`↔`injectGridX` normalization. 47/47 events. Prop keys: React 24 = Vue 24.
- INVARIANT: a public export added to one adapter is mirrored in the SAME PR; `index.ts` is the canonical surface. `AllFeatureProps<TRow>` stays identical React/Vue.
- DECIDED (#289): cell/editor context generics use asymmetric defaults `TRow = unknown`, `TValue = any` (Vue `CellSlotProps`/`EditorSlotProps`/`GridCellContext`/`GridEditorContext`; React `GridCellContext`/`GridEditorContext`). WHY: `unknown` for row safety; `any` for `TValue` unblocks single-generic `CellSlotProps<MyRow>`. Tests: `slot-types.spec.ts`, `context-types.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (#438, nested dotted-path fields): all three adapters inherit nested-path `field` automatically (their `ColumnConfig` `Omit`s only renderers). Each gained a defaulted `TField extends string = ColumnFieldKey<TRow>` generic (`GridConfig<Deal, NestedPaths<Deal>>`). GOTCHA: adapters alias core `ColumnConfig` as `BaseColumnConfig`, and core `ColumnConfig<TRow, TField>` has only **2** params — write `extends Omit<BaseColumnConfig<TRow, TField>, …>`; `<TRow, any, TField>` fails ng-packagr with `TS2707`. `ColumnFieldKey`/`NestedPaths` re-exported from all three `index.ts`; context `field` types are `string`. Tests: `nested-field-parity.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (v3, #261/#262): `SSRProps`/`ssr` REMOVED from React and Vue → `AllFeatureProps<TRow> = FeatureProps<TRow>` (React also dropped the `ssr` destructure + `featurePlugins` skip in `data-grid.tsx`). Vue also dropped the deprecated `makeFlushFocusedInput` re-export from `vue-grid-adapter.ts`.
- TENSION: idiomatic differences are NOT parity gaps (`<DataGrid>` vs `<TbwGrid>`, render props vs slots, `GridElementContext` vs `GRID_ELEMENT_KEY`, `PortalManager` vs `TeleportManager`).
- DECIDED (2026-08, `BaseGridEditorCVA` stale-value fix): NO React/Vue counterpart needed. WHY: only Angular ships a library-owned value resolver (`displayValue = currentValue() ?? cvaValue()`) that could contradict `commitBoth()`; React/Vue editors get raw `value` + `commit()` and own local state. Shared root cause: `EditingPlugin` skips `source: 'user'`, so `value` goes stale in `mode: 'row'`. `use-grid-overlay.ts` mirrors `BaseOverlayEditor` positioning/dismissal only.

## parity audit (2026-08, pre-3.0 sweep)

- INVARIANT (column props): an adapter column component may ONLY expose props core reads. `parseLightDomColumns()` (`core/internal/columns.ts`) reads `field, type, header, sortable, width, minWidth|min-width, order, resizable, options`; plugins add `editable`, `hidden`+`lock-visible`, `pinned`. Core `ColumnConfig` has NO `align`, NO `maxWidth`.
- INVARIANT (tool panel props): `id, title, icon, tooltip, order` only (`plugins/shell/shell.ts` ~l.492). Vue `label` = deliberate alias for `title`.
- INVARIANT (accessors): all 5 feature accessors expose `isReady` in all 3 adapters; `useGrid`/`injectGrid` expose `ready()`. Guarded by `src/features/accessor-parity.spec.ts` (React+Vue). Source: `@internal useGridIsReady(getGrid)` in `lib/use-grid-is-ready.ts`.
- DECIDED (removed outright \u2014 all verified no-ops, zero reads anywhere in `libs/grid/src`, so NOT breaking): Vue `TbwGridColumn.align`/`maxWidth`, Vue `TbwGridToolPanel.position`/`width`, React `GridColumn.format`/`multi`, React's inert `data-has-format`/`data-has-options` markers. Each only set an attribute nothing consumed.
- DECIDED: Vue `useGrid().gridElement` \u2192 **`element`** (matches React/Angular); `gridElement` RETAINED as a `@deprecated` alias pointing at the SAME `Ref` \u2014 no breaking change, no duplicated state. Vue `getConfig()` \u2192 `Promise<GridConfig<TRow>|null>` (core `getConfig` was already async, so this is a type fix); `getVisibleColumns()` reads the EFFECTIVE config, not the `gridConfig` prop; Angular `injectGrid().getConfig()` now `await`s. NOT renamed: `useGridOverlay({ gridElement })` and core `ToolPanelContext.gridElement` \u2014 different APIs.
- INVARIANT (where shared adapter helpers live): a helper needed by two adapters is MIRRORED per adapter, NOT promoted into core. `serializeColumnOptions` + `ColumnOptions` live in `libs/grid-{react,vue}/src/lib/column-options.ts` as verbatim twins. DECIDED (2026-09): promoting it to `core/internal/columns.ts` + `public.ts` was implemented, measured, and REVERTED — it cost +210 B raw / **+70 B gzipped** on `index.js`, which was already 48.37 kB against `maxGzip: 50 kB` / `warnGzip: 45 kB` (`vite.config.ts` ~l.492), i.e. ~4% of the remaining 1.63 kB headroom for code NO core consumer calls. Core slimness outranks adapter DRY. Drift is contained instead by a round-trip test in each `column-options.spec.ts` that re-implements core's CSV grammar as a tripwire. Same reasoning as the older `makeFlushFocusedInput` mirror.
- `useGridIsReady(getGrid)` (`@internal`, React `lib/use-grid-is-ready.ts` + Vue mirror) is the SINGLE `isReady` implementation WITHIN each adapter \u2014 consumed by `useGrid` AND all 5 feature accessors. Do not re-inline ready-tracking. Angular has no equivalent helper: its accessors track the flag inline because signals need no hook boundary.
- `plugins` escape hatch on all three (`<DataGrid plugins>`, `:plugins`, `[plugins]`): when set, feature props/directives are SKIPPED; merge `[...manual, ...feature, ...configPlugins]`.
- INVARIANT (`plugins` presence test): gate on PROVIDED-vs-not (`manualPlugins !== undefined` / `if (manualPlugins)`), NEVER on `.length > 0`. `plugins={[]}` is a deliberate "no plugins" override; a non-empty test makes the config effect early-return, silently leaving a previously applied set active when the input transitions `[X] → []`. React had this right; Angular's `grid.directive.ts` did not (fixed via PR #473 review). The write-side ternary needs the same guard — fall back to `userConfig.plugins` only when the input was absent.
- `canUndo()`/`canRedo()` keep an identical **call** shape (Angular signals are callable); React/Vue reactivity via a `historyVersion` bump on `undo`/`redo`/`cell-commit`, not from the plugin.
- Header triad: React `headerRenderer`/`headerLabelRenderer` render props ↔ Vue `#header`/`#headerLabel` slots ↔ Angular `*tbwHeader`/`*tbwHeaderLabel` (`directives/grid-column-header.directive.ts`; two `Map<HTMLElement, TemplateRef>` registries; walk up to `TBW-GRID-COLUMN`/`TBW-GRID-TYPE`).
- React feature registry (`registerFeature`, `getFeatureFactory`, `getRegisteredFeatures`, `isFeatureRegistered`, `clearFeatureRegistry`, `createPluginFromFeature`, `FeatureName`, `PluginFactory`) is now publicly exported, matching Vue/Angular.
- NON-GAPS (do not "fix"): `<DataGrid>` vs `<TbwGrid>`; render props vs slots vs directives; `useGrid()` vs `injectGrid()`; Angular's attribute-passthrough column directive; Angular's 11-grid/36-directive event split; React-only `registerChildFeatureDetector`; Angular-only `registerFeatureConfigPreprocessor`; Angular `visibleColumns` Signal vs `getVisibleColumns()`; `pinned` absent from React AND Vue equally.
- GOTCHAS: (a) accessors must optional-chain `grid.on?.()`/`unsub?.()`; spec stubs omit `on`. (b) `SelectionChangeDetail['mode']` is `SelectionMode | SelectionMode[]` — always `Array.isArray()`-branch. Framework-specific gotchas live in `adapters-{react,vue,angular}.md`.

## cross-adapter tensions

- WEAKMAP FALLBACK: dual lookup (WeakMap → field name → factory) is needed because re-renders create new DOM elements.
- PORTAL/TELEPORT OVERHEAD: mounting framework components into web-component cells needs a bridge managing lifecycle outside the framework tree.
